maria: Quick sync re: postmortem follow-ups for the 2026-03-19 billing ingestion incident (delayed events + double-counted tokens). Need owners + ETAs so finance/support can notify customers. Doc: https://redwood.internal/pm/billing-0319

Remediation slate:
1) Ingest dedupe fix (root cause: retry dedupe gap) - owner: unclaimed - ETA:?
2) Idempotent backfill for 2026-03-19..21 delayed/missing events - owner: unclaimed - ETA:?
3) Customer invoice credits & manual adjustments - owner: unclaimed - ETA:?
4) Alerting/metric to catch ingest vs upstream delta - owner: unclaimed - ETA:?
5) Postmortem update + recurring-pattern analysis - owner: unclaimed - ETA:?

ajay: I can take #1. Will triage today, build a rollback-safe patch and add a retry dedupe integration test. ETA patch: 2026-03-25 10:00 PT.

kyla: I9ll own #3 (credits). Plan: generate impacted-subscription list, propose credit amounts, run 10-customer pilot, then bulk. Pilot by 2026-03-26, bulk by 2026-03-30. Coordinating with support for messaging.

sam: I'll take #2 (backfill). Need to run a counts diff then an idempotent backfill job that only applies delta. Will post SQL and dry-run results by 3pm PT.

sam: SQL preview:
```sql
WITH ordered AS (
  SELECT request_id, event_ts, token_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY request_id ORDER BY event_ts) as rn
  FROM ingestion.events
  WHERE event_ts BETWEEN '2026-03-19' AND '2026-03-21'
)
SELECT request_id, SUM(token_count) as total_tokens, COUNT(*) as occurrences
FROM ordered
WHERE rn = 1
GROUP BY request_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;
```
This gives us deltas to apply idempotently.

"Hi — we9re contacting customers who saw inflated usage on 2026-03-19 due to a transient ingestion issue. We9ll apply a small credit and follow up with an invoice correction. No action required. Reply if you need details."

maria: add expected credit amount range and link to FAQ. Also include outbound email owner.

sam: dry-run results (staging): found 2,364 duplicate token events across 78 requests, delta tokens = 41,892. Scheduling production backfill 2026-03-25 01:30 UTC (low-traffic).

ajay: will ship dedupe patch 2026-03-25 06:00 UTC, enable dup-detection flag in canary for 2 hours, then promote if stable.

maria: recurring-pattern note: similar to Dec 2025 incident but smaller. @ajay add a section on recurrence root cause and guardrails. Also add alert: ingestion lag >5m AND delta(token_ingest, upstream_events) >0.5%.

ajay: will draft alert thresholds (rate + absolute) and post by EOD.

kyla: created finance tickets FIN-4821 (manual credits) and FIN-4822 (invoice adjustments). Will attach customer list when ready.
